limitations.note: The rewrite matches the corrected default waveform but changes pulse widths for some parameter overrides: with div_e=10, it holds the output high for five cycles instead of the four produced by the minimal fix.

The default waveform check could catch the original bug, but the override check encoded the rewrite’s new half-period rule rather than verifying that the existing parameterized behavior was preserved.
